title: Extract Expense Functions
prompt: Refactor an expense script into separate functions for validation, total calculation, and summary formatting, leaving main to coordinate them.
successCriteria: Every function has focused parameters and a clear return type.
Business functions return results rather than printing.
The main function reads as a short sequence of meaningful calls.
hints: Use question-style naming for the Boolean validation function.
Keep println at the outer program boundary.
solutionOutline: Write and call a calculation function.
Write and call a validation function.
Format the valid result in a separate function.
verification: Call each function with a second example.
Explain each parameter and returned value without reading the body.
